observer: Assistant visual inspection; not human ratings
exposure: Creator references, qualification/calibration depictions/results and both completed seed-41 matched blocks are known. Method-named technical receipts may be known, but neither seed-42 public-ID mapping has been read. All eighteen anonymous sparse grids and both creator references were inspected before saving this record. Recognizable prior depictions mean method-blinded, not independent double-blind human review. No held-out numerical similarity scores were computed.
sampling: 21 chronological 4-fps samples per Cxx-frames.jpg, 320-pixel-wide cells in a 5x5 grid; 378 candidate samples total with four black padding cells per grid. All-124-frame and unchanged-waveform inspection required for every candidate before method unblinding.
inference_before_unblinding: Several Series30 clips raise/open and close the book mid-clip or start with a raised cover/book, instead of an unambiguous closed-book-only hand-placement sequence. Sully C10 contains two similar depictions, one stationary and one boxing; cause of the extra figure is unresolved. Sully C02/C05 retain vest and short horns but differ in jaw/brow/teeth, C04/C12 show long-horned/bearded designs with vest, and five others omit vest. Boxing repetitions and ending differences require all frames. No method attribution, exact impact counts, audio judgments or overall winner.
